title: Request Pulse — compact decomposition widget for failed-request insights
creator: Priya Shah
description: Design a compact, embeddable Console card called 'Request Pulse' that surfaces a decomposed view of recent failed requests for a selected route/model. The widget consolidates cluster-level failure signals, retry lineage, error taxonomy breakdown, and a lightweight payload-diff preview into a single compact tile suitable for dashboards and rollout pages. It should help engineers quickly decide whether to investigate, rollout a fix, or act with an automated rollback. Scope: visual design, interaction spec, prototype (Figma + HTML/CSS), and handoff artifacts for ENG to implement a first-pass mobile-friendly card and an expanded modal for deep inspection.
acceptance_criteria: Compact card displays top 3 failure clusters for the selected route with counts and trend sparkline
Clicking a cluster opens an expanded modal with retry lineage, error taxonomy, and a payload-diff peek
Payload-diff preview highlights changed keys and shows truncated before/after pairs with a copy-to-clipboard action
Cost indicator shows estimated retry token-cost and cost delta compared to last successful window
Card fits within existing dashboard grid (1x1) with responsive behavior down to 320px width
Design handoff includes component specs, color tokens, accessibility contrast checks, and a small interaction prototype in Figma
decisions: Use compact three-cluster summary rather than a long list to keep cognitive load low
Represent error taxonomy as progressive disclosure: top-level category + percent, drill-down to exemplar error messages
Retry lineage visualized as a concise left-to-right strip with timestamps and outcome badges (succeeded/failed) rather than a full DAG
Payload preview is read-only and limited to key fields; full payload download handled via Console backend entitlement
Cost delta computed on tokens-per-request multiplied by retry count and surfaced as a red/green microchip in the card header

design_notes: Visual hierarchy: card header (route, time window, cost microchip), body (three cluster tiles horizontally), footer (secondary actions: expand, filter)
Cluster tile: small circular sparkline, top error category tag, count, and relative trend chevron
Expanded modal: left column retry lineage strip, center taxonomy stacked list with sample messages, right column payload-diff peek with before/after rows
Interactions: hover shows tooltip with sample error message; cluster click opens modal; 'investigate' preloads top-5 requests into triage workspace
Accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for tag backgrounds, keyboard focus for all actionable elements, aria-live for streaming cluster counts
